description:
What is under Antarctica's ice? Doug gets lowered down a hot-water borehole past 11 real places hidden beneath the ice sheet, from Blood Falls at the surface to Lake Vostok and the deepest point on land, more than 4 km down, and almost every stop has something living (or moving) where nothing should.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
